sections.heading: How to Start an Agricultural Seeds Selling Business in India
paragraphs: Just like any other country, seed culture and agriculture is vital to the economy of the country and India is not an exception. Agriculture when coupled with the economy, gives rise to hybrid seeds and crops which allows profitable business opportunities. As an entrepreneur, it is crucial to understand every aspect of the business. Hence, there is a need to register an agricultural seed selling licence.
There is a reason for you to consider this business. This pensions reason is what augers well for the seed selling business.
One of the world’s largest agricultural sector gives you the assurance of a never ending demand for seeds.
The government’s pro seed distribution and innovation policies insures support for seed sellers.
There is an insatiable need for and thus fantastic profit margins from hybrid crop seeds, certified seeds and other specialized seeds.
There is a need for authentic seeds, crop productivity is lacking and most farmer’s are struggling. The positive impact of this seed selling business is there to be made.
These are reasons enough but before commencing the business, you have to register yourself as a seed seller.

Every person or legal entity wishing to engage in the selling, distributing, or trading of agricultural seeds is required to obtain a license as set forth under the Seeds Act of 1966. Selling or distributing seeds without a license is a criminal offense.
The objectives of seed licence registration in India focus on:
Distributing agricultural seeds of the best quality.
Protecting the standards of germination, purity, and variety.
Controlling seed traders and curbing malpractice.
Every business wanting to open a seed shop must be informed of the various categories of licenses that can be issued:
Agricultural Seeds Retailers License: For retailers that would wish to sell seeds directly to the farmers.
Seed Wholesale License: For companies that engage in the bulk supply of seeds to retailers.
